baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَوَّعَتْ لَهُ نَفْسُهُ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is cast as an inner agent that smooths and encourages a resisted possibility until fratricide becomes doable; the move from the nominal killing to the finite he-killed-him marks conversion of inward facilitation into completed act.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the literal easing and encouragement by the self, functioning as the mechanism that lowers resistance to the act.
Locates intention and deliberative content within the self, allowing it to operate as an internal persuader.
The repeated life-ending sense links the contemplated object directly to its execution.
Makes the target a kin relation rather than an interchangeable victim, intensifying what the self must make easy.

changed_reading.before: A man simply decided to kill his brother.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an internal production process: the self first makes fratricide compliant and feasible, and only then does the contemplated killing become an accomplished verb.

baseline_models.mechanism: A living self and a brotherly tether are joined in the victim; killing severs that tether and removes life, so the killer's loss is reflexive diminution of his own relational self rather than an external penalty alone.

activation_trace.role: Contributes life-bearing selfhood, making murder removal of a living person rather than only an aggressive motion.
Images brotherhood as a fastening bond, so killing functions as severance of a relation that also held the killer.
Supplies the irreversible removal that breaks the living bond.
Frames the result as subtraction from the killer, not acquisition through eliminating a rival.

changed_reading.before: He loses something as a consequence of killing another person.
changed_reading.after: By extinguishing his brother's life and cutting their tether, he diminishes the relational structure of his own self; the homicide is already self-loss.

baseline_models.mechanism: The completed act immediately changes the actor's standing. The commercial branch of loss casts the apparent success of killing as a transaction that consumes its own capital and enrolls him among deficit-bearers.

activation_trace.role: Provides the completed act that triggers the following change of state.
Marks becoming rather than merely feeling, assigning a new condition after the deed.
Contributes the failed-trade image, making the supposedly advantageous murder a destruction of capital.

changed_reading.before: The killer later suffers an unspecified bad consequence.
changed_reading.after: The murder itself closes as a losing exchange: accomplishment and deficit coincide, and the actor immediately becomes a member of the losing class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dialogue first voices a future killing, then explicitly opens and refuses a hand-for-hand killing relation. Against that refusal, the focus self's facilitation is no longer generic temptation: it is what carries a threat across the victim's nonreciprocity into unilateral execution.

activation_trace.role: Functions as the inner encouragement that overcomes the absence of reciprocal aggression.
Registers the threat's eventual realization as actual life-taking.
Supplies the announced but not yet executed killing, establishing the unrealized starting point.
Makes extension of the hand the practical interface of violence and marks the victim's refusal to activate that interface.
Opens a possible two-party combat frame only for the victim's speech to decline his side of it.

structural_cues: 5:27 places killing in a quoted future threat; 5:30 repeats it first as a nominal object and then as a completed finite verb.
5:28 mirrors hand extension and killing across two speakers but negates the victim's corresponding action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, mirrored hand language, refusal, and later execution; I infer that self-facilitation bridges the blocked reciprocal frame into one-sided violence. Alternatively, the dialogue may only narrate escalation without specifying what inward resistance was overcome.

changed_reading.before: The self makes a violent intention easy.
changed_reading.after: The self manufactures unilateral executability precisely where the other brother has refused to make the encounter mutual.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self can facilitate the difficult destructive act, but after the killing the actor cannot devise the elementary care of covering his brother until shown. This ability inversion recasts self-facilitation as selective competence: agency is efficient toward destruction and deficient toward custodial aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Contributes attained capacity, which the aftermath exposes as narrowly available for the killing.
Identifies the self as what made the destructive task easy, setting up the later competence reversal.
Keeps both violence and failed care attached to the same brotherly relation.
Supplies the concrete custodial task of placing the exposed body out of sight.
Names the actor's incapacity after his self had already produced capacity for murder.
Makes belated regret arise from confronting the failed aftermath rather than from preventing the act.

structural_cues: The same brother recurs as the object first of killing and then of covering.
Demonstration by a nonhuman agent intervenes between the actor's incapacity and his regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facilitation, completed killing, inability, demonstrated covering, and regret; I infer a morally inverted distribution of competence. A live alternative is simple ignorance of burial practice rather than a diagnosis of selective agency.

changed_reading.before: His self grants him enough resolve to perform the murder.
changed_reading.after: His agency is distorted rather than simply strong: it can make fratricide easy but cannot generate care for the brotherly body it has produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent repetition of became-among with different complements separates two stages. Killing first makes him one of the losers; only after the body's exposure and the lesson in covering does he become one of the regretful. Loss therefore cannot be reduced to remorse.

activation_trace.role: Marks the first acquired state immediately after killing.
Names objective diminution as the first post-deed classification.
Repeats the same state-transition operator after a further episode, making a second stage visible.
Supplies retrospective sorrow as the later state, distinct from the prior loss.

structural_cues: 5:30 and 5:31 close with the same فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ construction.
The covering episode stands between membership among the losers and membership among the regretful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact syntactic echo with ordered, different predicates; I infer that the order differentiates objective loss from conscious regret. Alternatively, the two labels can overlap affectively even while the narration stages them separately.

changed_reading.before: Calling him a loser means that he regretted the murder.
changed_reading.after: The act constitutes loss before the narrative displays regret; remorse is a later recognition of a deficit already incurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit causal bridge carries this killing into an obligatory formulation, and the paired killing-preserving comparison scales one life to humanity as an undiminished whole. The murdered brother becomes a representative human relation; the killer's loss expands from private damage to subtraction from the shared human total.

activation_trace.role: Provides the severed brotherly tether that can be generalized as a human bond.
Supplies diminution, now enlarged from one actor's deficit to damage to a collective whole.
Makes the preceding event an explicit cause for the following normative expansion.
Converts the event's implication into an established, obligating judgment.
Repeats life-taking on both the individual and humanity-wide sides of the comparison.
Identifies the protected unit as living selfhood and supports equivalence between lives.
Supplies humanity in contrast to the nonhuman, widening the brother from kin member to human representative.
Contributes completeness without missing parts, so one killing registers as damage to the human whole.
Provides the counter-mechanism of preserving life by refraining from killing, clarifying what the focus act destroys.

structural_cues: 5:32 begins with an explicit because-of-that bridge from the preceding episode.
Killing one life and preserving one life are each compared with all humanity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causal bridge, legal inscription, and individual-to-total comparison; I infer that the focus loss includes communal subtraction and that brotherhood is the local instance of human solidarity. Alternatively, 5:32 may generalize the rule without defining the semantic range of الخاسرين.

changed_reading.before: Fratricide destroys one kin relationship and makes its perpetrator lose.
changed_reading.after: The brother's death is the local fracture through which loss becomes species-wide: removing one life damages the imagined completeness of humanity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later written life-for-life sequence supplies measured public equivalence and even a route of voluntary relinquishment. Set against it, the focus self privately authorizes an irreversible taking. The deficient-measure branch of loss makes fratricide an act that shortchanges the brother's life by replacing accountable measure with inward permission.

activation_trace.role: Functions as private facilitation, the unauthorized inner substitute for a measured public process.
Contributes short measure, rendering the killing a radical undervaluation of the brother's life.
Supplies an established obligation against which private self-authorization can be contrasted.
Places living self against living self as the unit that must be measured rather than casually removed.
Contributes calibrated matching of consequence to injury, the opposite of unilateral fratricide.
Adds voluntary surrender of a due claim, distinguishing accountable generosity from the focus self's destructive easing.

structural_cues: 5:45 arranges life and body parts in repeated balanced pairs.
The measured sequence allows the holder of a claim to relinquish it, unlike the victim's unchosen loss in 5:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-facilitation, a loss branch of deficient measure, and later calibrated reciprocity; I infer that private murder is an under-measuring of life and a usurpation of judgment. Alternatively, the later rule can regulate a different legal setting without retrospectively specifying the focus loss.

changed_reading.before: خاسرين evokes a broadly losing outcome after murder.
changed_reading.after: The killer is a loser also as a false measurer: his self treats a brother's life as expendable where accountable equivalence treats life as irreducible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later two-ayah chain moves from what is hidden in selves, through becoming regretful, to intended deeds collapsing and the exact formula becoming losers. That echo exposes the focus architecture: inwardly managed purpose becomes outward act, but the apparent achievement nullifies itself and fixes a public state of loss.

activation_trace.role: Locates the enabling purpose inside the actor before it externalizes as killing.
Converts the private-to-active sequence into an acquired, visible status.
Names the resulting deficit that the later echo ties to collapsed action.
Supplies concealment in the interior, sharpening the focus self as a hidden site of operative purpose.
Repeats the self as container of intent, linking inward calculation to later exposure.
Adds belated sorrow when the concealed calculation meets its outcome.
Contributes collapse and descent, making the actors' purposeful deeds lose effective value.
Identifies what collapses as intentional action, paralleling the focus movement from intent to deed.
Repeats the focus transition into an assigned condition.
Completes the exact later echo by naming diminution after deeds have failed.

structural_cues: 5:52 places concealed content in selves immediately before regret.
5:53 couples collapsed deeds with the same أصبحوا خاسرين closure used in singular form at 5:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the inner-self sequence, regret, deed-collapse, and exact loss formula; I infer a shared causal architecture in which a privately pursued gain self-nullifies. Alternatively, the later actors form an independent analogy and the repeated closure may be thematic rather than mechanistically identical.

changed_reading.before: The self successfully produces a murder and loss is an added consequence.
changed_reading.after: The inward project externalizes successfully only at the surface; at the level of value, the deed collapses into the very loss-status it produces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later branch image of making something pliant after difficulty occurs in a relational instruction that places yielding on the side of fellow believers. It reorients the focus easing as a misallocated capacity: inward pliancy is used to overcome inhibition against harming a brother rather than to sustain gentleness toward him.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the focus's making-easy process, whose object is the brother's killing.
Anchors the moral misdirection in a relation that ordinarily calls for solidarity.
Provides a second making-pliant image in a pro-social relation, exposing the focus facilitation as directed toward the wrong end.

structural_cues: 5:54 distributes relational softness toward believers and strength toward opponents.
5:30 directs an easing process toward killing the explicitly named brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two facilitation or pliancy images and contrasting relational objects; I infer moral misallocation of a neutral capacity. Alternatively, the roots may remain only analogically related, so this reading should not replace the direct sense of self-encouragement.

changed_reading.before: The self's easing is simply an increase in violent resolve.
changed_reading.after: The tragedy includes a reversal of relational pliancy: the faculty that could soften conduct toward a brother instead softens the prohibition against destroying him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wasted-blood edge of حبط in a later statement about deeds becoming void; it remains anchored by the focus killing-loss sequence and the exact later became-losers echo. Downstream prose should present it as a cross-verse material analogy, not as the direct lexical meaning of either قتل or خسر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَاسِرِينَ

activation_trace.role: Supplies the brother's shed life as the material event later branch imagery can reactivate.
Frames the intended gain as a transaction that fails to return value.
Contributes the image of a slain person's blood being rendered waste, linking voided action to the focus corpse.
Makes the canceled item an intentional deed, permitting comparison with the focus's achieved project.
Repeats the transition from deed to a newly fixed standing.
Reproduces the focus outcome after action-nullification, supporting the analogy of self-canceling gain.

changed_reading.before: The murder achieves its immediate object even though the killer later becomes a loser.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the brother's wasted blood makes the project void at inception: the apparent gain is a deed that cancels its own value and leaves only loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples a nonprimary dawn-opening branch of نفس with the literal-morning branch of أصبح and later concealment imagery. It remains anchored in adjacent focus roots and the packet's repeated hiding-and-becoming pattern; render it only as an evoked exposure image, never as a replacement translation for نفسه or أصبح.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an opening or spreading like daybreak, imaging the inward impulse as something that will emerge.
Adds literal dawn as the image of transition from hidden inward preparation to exposed loss.
Supplies the attempted re-covering of what the killing has made bodily visible.
Reactivates inner concealment before a later became-regretful transition.

changed_reading.before: He simply becomes a loser after the act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained poetic activation, what the self prepared inwardly breaks open like dawn: the corpse may be covered, but the killer's loss has passed into exposure.

strongest_changes: The victim's refusal of reciprocal violence makes the self's facilitation specifically a bridge to unilateral execution.
The exact adjacent أصبح construction shows that loss is incurred before regret is narrated.
The causal and humanity-wide comparison in 5:32 scales severed brotherhood into damage to the human whole.
The later echo of hidden selves, collapsed deeds, and becoming losers reveals the murder as an inward project that nullifies its own gain.
summary.what_was_special: This focus is unusually activated by reversals of capacity and scale: the self can enable killing but not care, one brother can stand for humanity's completeness, and an apparently successful deed can itself constitute deficit. Exact later repetitions of نفس, أصبح, and خسر keep these mechanisms anchored while allowing the wasted-blood and dawn-exposure branches to remain visible as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The extent to which الخاسرين in the focus itself carries commercial or deficient-measure imagery rather than general diminution remains open.
The legal reciprocity of 5:45 may illuminate the focus retrospectively without defining the original killer's precise loss.
The pliancy, wasted-blood, and dawn-exposure readings depend on branch-level analogy and should coexist with, not displace, the direct internal-facilitation reading.
